findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 274 requests to 12 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 14.6 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 9.1 MB (62%) came from third-party domains, 2.5 MB of it from services classified as tracking (29 requests).

6 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), imasdk.googleapis.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics), newsroom.bi (Marfeel, analytics).
12 cookies were set by third-party domains (21 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 135 requests were blocked. The page still made 274 requests to 12 third-party domains, including 6 tracking services in our list.
